snippet.title: The Architects of the Universe: The Orbital Wars development trailer
snippet.description:
The development trailer for the prequel to AotU: The Orphans I am proud to present The Orbital Wars!

Featuring a stronger focus on varied gameplay as well at enthralling storyline.

The game explores the events leading up to humanity's departure from Earth which leads to the events of The Orphans.

The plot is setup in three acts: Pre-War, Beginning of War, and End of War.
Follow the main character Leo, and the seven companions you recruit in Act 1 in a war with Bhurl, an orbiting city-state made up of wealthy elites who use their orbiting stations to extort the people living on Earth until they couldn't take anymore.

Featuring the pixel art of Final Boss Blues, Kokoro Reflections, and audio from Bit by Bit sound!

The game will be beta tested on Itch.IO with full release there and on Steam!
Be sure to follow development blogs found on Itch.io/the-orbital-wars

Trailer Song: Cloudbreaker by Bit by Bit Sound
